text:
[LCYC.3.1] The compiler builds the rule dependency graph at
compile time and rejects cycles in it with `DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE`.

idris.name: Lcyc_3_1__edge_mono
idris.note: Every edge goes to an equal or LATER stratum. This clause rejects cycles, under which every edge goes strictly later; equality (rules sharing an SCC) is what [LCYC.3.1.1] admits, and is admitted here for that reason. Partial because the definition models the pair of clauses, not this one alone.

idris.name: Lcyc_3_1__in_range
idris.note: Every rule's stratum is below the count.

idris.name: Lcyc_3_1__strata
idris.note: A stratification: a stratum per rule index and a stratum count. A topological order of the clause's SCC-DAG is one.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__emit_kinds_of
idris.note: The kinds a stratum's rules emit.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__read_kinds_of
idris.note: The kinds a stratum's rules read, positive and `no`.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__withdraw_kinds_of
idris.note: The kinds a stratum's rules withdraw.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__indices_in_elem
idris.note: An index in the list names a rule of stratum i.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__indices_in_has
idris.note: A rule index of stratum i is in the index list.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__not_read_below
idris.note: A rule of an earlier stratum never reads a kind a later stratum writes -- the consequence of edge monotonicity the measure needs.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__not_read_same
idris.note: A rule does not read what its stratum does not read.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__rules_in_elem
idris.note: A rule of stratum i is in the stratum's rule list.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__rules_in_index
idris.note: A rule in the list has an index in stratum i.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__stratum_below_not_read
idris.note: No stratum below the writer's reads what it writes.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__withdraw_of_sub_read
idris.note: What a stratum withdraws it reads.

idris.name: Lcyc_3_1__emitted_from
idris.note: A kind emitted by a rule of stratum i or above: what a cascade during a firing at i can retract.

idris.name: lcyc_3_1__below_reads_none
idris.note: No stratum below i reads a kind emitted at i or above: edge monotonicity.
